slot.brief: Compare rms speeds of two gases at the same/specified temperatures using v_rms ∝ √(T/M); find the ratio or the unknown temperature.

stem: Gas $X$ has molar mass $4$ g mol$^{-1}$ at $300$ K, and gas $Y$ has molar mass $16$ g mol$^{-1}$ at $600$ K. What is the ratio of their rms speeds, $v_X/v_Y$?

verdicts.working: Using v_rms = sqrt(3RT/M), v_X/v_Y = sqrt[(300/4)/(600/16)] = sqrt(2).

working:
$v_{\rm rms}\propto\sqrt{T/M}$
$\dfrac{v_X}{v_Y}=\sqrt{\dfrac{300/4}{600/16}}=\sqrt{2}$ Independent check: Using v_rms = sqrt(3RT/M), v_X/v_Y = sqrt[(300/4)/(600/16)] = sqrt(2).
